policies.title: Congolese ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Congolese visitor and makes the electronic tourist-visa route available from anywhere except the United States.
conditions: Use an ordinary Republic of the Congo passport. Cuba names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; a Congolese ordinary-passport holder without Cuban residency must obtain the tourist visa.
Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel; Cuba's D'Viajeros declaration is separate. The tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, with a possible 90-day extension.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Congolese ordinary passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Congolese ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service makes an online, emailed tourism visa available to citizens of all countries, subject to stated waiver exceptions and ordinary passport validity.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary Republic of the Congo passport with at least six months' validity, photo, return ticket and the listed supporting evidence. The F5A route is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days.

Apply online, upload documents and pay the fee. The Nigeria Immigration Service document says the applicant receives the visa certificate by email; this is electronic issuance, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

The source excepts ECOWAS member states and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. It does not identify the Republic of the Congo as an exception. Work, residence, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa service
steps: Apply online using the Congolese ordinary passport and upload the required tourism documents.
Pay the fee and await the emailed visa certificate before travel.
Use the electronic certificate subject to carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Congolese citizens: Republic of the Congo
policies.summary: The Republic of the Congo's official ordinary-passport decree identifies the holder as a Congolese citizen, while the current entry statute regulates foreigners; entry to the holder's own state is classified as citizenship rather than a visitor-visa route.
conditions: This records nationality/citizenship only. Passport validity, border operations, identity documentation, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.
